findings: The five courses partition the eleven capability claims exactly and retain acyclic prerequisites.
The stereo world projects one target symmetrically with larger disparity for nearer depth while leaking no target, depth, disparity, course, or verdict metadata.
BinocularDepth rejects ordinary gaze, one accidental vergence event, and monocular consequence; it requires repeated vergence consequences in both eyes.
Seeds 31001 and 91003 acquire gaze contingency, gaze control, and hand contingency; Eye Control stops at BinocularDepth and Hand and Finger Control stops independently at DigitSeparation.
Failed lesson checkpoints do not contaminate independent courses; their transcripts retain exact replay.
No learner-core or human-body source changed, and no verification finding refutes the bounded plan claim.
residual_uncertainty: The learner does not yet demonstrate the new binocular-depth capability.
The stereo claim does not establish distance estimation, depth-directed reaching, object permanence, or general 3D understanding.
Eye-Hand Coordination and later manipulation courses remain not reached until both independent foundation frontiers are acquired.
Existing later capability evaluators still need separate selectivity audits when their prerequisites become reachable.
